brief:
## Decided
- The project will be divided into three design phases. [TS3012a: "we'll take this project in three steps"]  
- Set the selling price at twenty‑five euros. [TS3012a: "Selling price, twenty five Euros. That's for you"]  
- Basic structure of the remote was decided. [TS3012b: "we have decided more or less the basic structure"]  
- The team chose rubber as the material. [TS3012c: "so we're definitely going for rubber"]  
- The team assumed a target of forty‑one units. [TS3012c: "let's just assume we go to forty one"]  

## Changed along the way
- Wood was dropped as a material option. [TS3012c: "No, wood i wood's not an option"]  
- The remote color concept was changed to yellow for a flashier look. [TS3012c: "I would take a yellow remote control"]
